## Personality

Ada is characterized by a persistent smile, which has been observed since Volume 3. This constant facial expression is noted by others as being particularly unsettling.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Farewell P21](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0021)_

## History

Ada is a woman who ceased aging after turning thirty, remaining thirty years old while her twin sister, [Hannah](../character/hannah.md), grew old. She lives alongside [Hannah](../character/hannah.md) in a quaint, charming house named Patty's Place located on [Spofford Avenue](../codex/places.md#avenue). Her home later catches the eye of [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), who feels a strong connection to the property during an afternoon walk.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Farewell P5](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0005), [v3 ch.Farewell P6](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0006), [v3 ch.Farewell P7](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0007), [v3 ch.Farewell P8](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0008), [v3 ch.Farewell P11](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0011), [v3 ch.Farewell P12](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0012), +73 more_
